surfaces: Yin-Yang Twin Polarity Thousand Slaughter Formation
lore_anchors.definition: A supreme-grade set of one thousand flying swords (500 Yin, 500 Yang) that can be deployed as a devastating formation, capable of annihilating everything in its path.
The advanced version of the Lesser Thousand Sword Formation, requiring a complex sigil and enabling the unified control of hundreds of flying swords.
A highly complex runic sigil imprinted onto flying swords used in the Grand Thousand Sword Formation, requiring significant time and energy to inscribe.
A second body cultivated by a Ki Refiner at the Primal Daoist stage, sharing the same soul and consciousness, capable of independent action and cultivation.
A divine ability that grants Ji Ning telescopic and clairvoyant vision, allowing him to see across vast distances.
A sect located within the East Forest Mountain Range, currently under the control of unknown powerful figures who have subjugated its members.
